messages.subject: Your subscription to the CorpLing for R list
parts:
Hi all

Going over the membership list of the CorpLing for R list, I noticed
that most of you haven't

- defined your name or set up a nickname (which is shown when you post
stuff to the list), which could of course be just your real full name
or whatever;
- set up your location;
- chose a way how to read this group (for example, switch to digest
emails etc.).

Now, of course you don't have to do this! I just wanted to let you
know that you *can* do this if you want to. Just go to the homepage of
the group at <http://groups.google.com/group/corpling-with-r> and
click on <Edit my membership >on the right. The reason for my
reminding you of this is that I hope that some time down the road the
traffic here will increase because I just signed a contract for my
corpus linguistics with R book with Routledge and

- this list will host the companion website for this book (<http://
groups.google.com/group/corpling-with-r/web/quantitative-corpus-
linguistics-with-r>);
- just like anyone else, readers of the book can become members of the
list to post questions about corpus linguistics with R, which
hopefully make us all learn more about this.

So much from your friendly list moderator, have a great weekend and
don't forget the list when you have questions that belong here!
Cheers,
STG
